effects: Grants the Automaton Control Bot which stores up to 20 weapon or armour gizmos, granting their effects while wearing augmented equipment.
Combat perks in stored gizmos have their rank doubled, excluding perks that do not benefit from additional ranks.
body.name: Power Archive

assumptions: Stored Archive ranks are doubled at resolve time; craftable maxima stay normal.
Duplicate perks use highest rank only (wiki Perks self-stack rule).
Augmented-equipment gate is treated as calculator Invention setup (Archive applies when blessing is active).
Ruthless stacks default to 0; Flanking requires targetNotFacing.
Defensive and skilling perks are selectable but not simulated for outgoing DPS.

reason: Wire Power Archive Automaton Control Bot and effective-rank combat path; keep defensive perks UI-only.
